title: Babel Styled Components Template Example Warning

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```
Operating System:
      Platform: darwin
      Arch: arm64
      Version: Darwin Kernel Version 21.6.0: Wed Aug 10 14:28:23 PDT 2022; root:xnu-8020.141.5~2/RELEASE_ARM64_T6000
    Binaries:
      Node: 16.14.0
      npm: 8.3.1
      Yarn: 1.22.15
      pnpm: 6.11.0
    Relevant packages:
      next: 12.2.6-canary.8
      eslint-config-next: N/A
      react: 17.0.2
      react-dom: 17.0.2
```

### Which example does this report relate to?

with-styled-components-babel

### What browser are you using? (if relevant)

Obera GX

### How are you deploying your application? (if relevant)

n/a

### Describe the Bug

Running this example with no changes produces a warning `Warning: Each child in a list should have a unique "key" prop`

```bash
fizzog:~$yarn dev
yarn run v1.22.15
warning ../package.json: No license field
$ next
ready - started server on 0.0.0.0:3000, url: http://localhost:3000
info  - Disabled SWC as replacement for Babel because of custom Babel configuration ".babelrc" https://nextjs.org/docs/messages/swc-disabled
info  - Using external babel configuration from /Users/fizzog/Documents/snap-next/.babelrc
event - compiled client and server successfully in 2.2s (185 modules)
wait  - compiling /_error (client and server)...
event - compiled client and server successfully in 41 ms (186 modules)
Warning: Each child in a list should have a unique "key" prop. See https://reactjs.org/link/warning-keys for more information.
    at Head (webpack-internal:///./node_modules/next/dist/pages/_document.js:349:1)
    at html
    at Html (webpack-internal:///./node_modules/next/dist/pages/_document.js:853:19)
    at MyDocument (webpack-internal:///./pages/_document.tsx:23:1)
warn  - Fast Refresh had to perform a full reload. Read more: https://nextjs.org/docs/basic-features/fast-refresh#how-it-works
wait  - compiling / (client and server)...
event - compiled client and server successfully in 62 ms (189 modules)
warn  - Fast Refresh had to perform a full reload. Read more: https://nextjs.org/docs/basic-features/fast-refresh#how-it-works
```

The warning is generated because of the return block in `_document.tsx`

```tsx
return {
  ...initialProps,
  styles: [
    <>
      {initialProps.styles}
      {sheet.getStyleElement()}
    </>,
  ],
}
```

### Expected Behavior

No warning is expected with a fresh install of this example. The fix is rather simple. Remove the array brackets and let the fragment return alone.

```tsx
return {
  ...initialProps,
  styles: (
    <>
      {initialProps.styles}
      {sheet.getStyleElement()}
    </>
  ),
}
```

### To Reproduce

1) Install the example
1) Start the dev server
1) Navigate to localhost:3000
1) See warning in dev console
